_README: RBS-New Brunswick Business Core for students who entered RBS in fall 2026, encoded ONCE and linked to each RBS major (Prompt 08 B1).

Source: the 2026-2027 catalog's major pages print the same 36-credit Business Core table; quoted here from the BAIT page. Courses are taken after admission to RBS (available_after_stage) - a plan never assumes admission.

Major-dependent overrides (Accounting majors take Accounting Information Systems, Business Law and Managerial Accounting) belong to the Accounting encoding (Phase C) and are listed under rules_not_yet_modeled.

OPEN CONFLICT BAIT-ETHICS: the same catalog page prints Business Ethics as 33:522:335 in the core table and 33:522:334 in its notes; the department pages print 334. The table's literal claim is encoded on the ethics branch, which stays conditional (unresolved_conflicts) until a human resolves it. No equivalence is invented.

business core course requirements that all students must complete regardless of their choice of major program

school_rules.name: One RBS course may count toward two RBS majors
school_rules.not_evaluable_reason: CoursePilot plans one major per student today; a cross-major overlap cap is recorded, not evaluated.

quotes.quote: Students with more than one Business School major may only double count one RBS course between those majors (not including the Business Core).

rules_not_yet_modeled.rule: Accounting majors (first, second or third major) take 33:010:458, 33:140:320 and 33:010:275; 33:522:334, 33:136:370 and 33:136:386 then earn graduation credit but no Accounting major credit.
rules_not_yet_modeled.why_not: A major-dependent override of the shared core; it is encoded with the Accounting major (Phase C), never applied to other majors.
rules_not_yet_modeled.quote: If you major in Accounting as your first, second, or third major, you are required to take 33:010:458 Accounting Information Systems, 33:140:320 Business Law I, and an additional course - 33:010:275 Managerial Accounting.

rules_not_yet_modeled.rule: A grade of B or better in 33:390:300 is needed to take further Finance courses.
rules_not_yet_modeled.why_not: A prerequisite-grade gate for later courses, not a completion rule of the core; it belongs to the Finance encoding.
rules_not_yet_modeled.quote: A grade of B or better in 33:390:300 Financial Management is required to take any additional Finance department courses.

rules_not_yet_modeled.rule: Credit for 33:011:300 Business Forum replaces 33:011:301, 302 and 303.
rules_not_yet_modeled.why_not: Stated only in an extraction-only department capture (phase08a-myrbs-bait), not in the catalog; recorded for review, not encoded.

rules_not_yet_modeled.rule: Students who entered RBS before fall 2026 follow a different (39-credit) business core.
rules_not_yet_modeled.why_not: A different cohort's curriculum (conflict register BAIT-CORE-COHORT); this component applies to fall-2026 entrants only.
